description: Open the verifiable execution loop: certify a swap/DeFi intent before the agent executes. Use it when a principal needs a signed pre-trade handle to bind an execution receipt later. Do not use it as trade authorization and do not call it after the trade. Returns preTradeUid, destinationPreTradeUid, requestHash, CAIP-19 asset ids, certified cross-rate, the 50 bps band, verdicts and the signed pre-trade attestations. Deprecated alias: prefer trade_proof with op "begin_evidence". Removed on 2027-01-06.

decision_input.description: Required quote evidence: {source, destination, routeQuotePrice, routeQuoteObservedAt} (old camelCase shape)
